candidates.title: Census State in Colorado 2010
candidates.description: Census Data is collected every 10 years by mail surveys to every household with primary data collection fields of population, gender, race and number of occupants for the entire state. Data includes demographics, education level, commute information, and more subset to Colorado by the Department of Local Affairs (DOLA).
